title: Lena and the Veil
author: I. M. Brightwater
blurb: Oscar Sandoval, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
